directions.plain: We put money behind your best photos. More women like you see them.
directions.title: Boost Best Posts to New Women
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand photos get the most love. This puts more eyes on those winners.
directions.you_would_do: Pick your 2 best on-hand photos and post 3 to 5 times this week.

directions.plain: You run one sale for seven days. Shoppers who waited will buy now.
directions.title: Run One Short Sale Week
directions.why_for_you: Sales pull extra strong for you. Last month you beat your goal even with few posts.
directions.you_would_do: Pick one week, pick a simple discount, and post 4 to 5 times that week.

directions.plain: You post almost every day. You spend no money and grow slow and steady.
directions.title: Post Often With No Spending
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand and close-up photos do best on their own. Our past guesses missed a few weeks so this keeps spend safe.
directions.you_would_do: Post 4 to 5 times a week using mostly on-hand photos.

directions.caution: Last month few creators posted so plan for extra no-shows.
directions.plain: You mail pieces to small creators. They post wearing photos for you.
directions.title: Send Pieces to More Creators
directions.why_for_you: Creator photos earn lots of love when they post. Your best posts are wearing shots.
directions.you_would_do: Message 10 women, mail 4 to 8 pieces, and ask for one on-hand photo each.
